source_note: All 15 items uniformly reverse-scored (6 - response) and averaged; higher mean indicates greater distress tolerance, per the standard scoring direction for this instrument. The four published subscales (Tolerance / Absorption / Appraisal / Regulation) are NOT implemented in this draft: their item-to-subscale assignment could not be verified against the original 2005 paper, which is not open access. Verify against the original before adding subscale scores.
